goal: Verify drive-memory persistence and repository access.
population: Prior-write/current-read persistence transitions and repository-access cases.
acceptance: Independent persisted bytes match prior accepted writes across invocations, with real repository-access evidence.
evidencePlan: Define cross-invocation write receipts and host-side read-back comparisons, treating first-run absence separately.
missingReason: Source requests agent read-back/reporting, without an independent persistence verifier; no transition evidence collected.
limitation: Same-run write/read or an issue saying previous state existed does not prove durable persistence.
